CORE MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #19
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 42
   C. 30
   D. 21

2. What is √64? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 9
   C. 64
   D. 8

3. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x + 2
   B. 6x
   C. 12x
   D. 6x + 2

4. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 34
   B. 22
   C. 17
   D. 66

5. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 37

6. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 43
   D. 1

7. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 49
   D. 1

8. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. 1/4
   C. Cannot tell
   D. 2/2

9. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

10. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 19.7
   C. 19.6
   D. 25

11. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x > 5
   B. x = 5
   C. x ≥ 0 only
   D. x < 5

12. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 25

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
